patients.name: Patient_001_Urgent_Potassium
patients.demo_beat: The agent identified three independent potassium-raising drugs coexisting in this patient's regimen. None alone would push K+ to 6.1; the combination explains the magnitude.
active_conditions_summary: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction
patients.notes: Headline demo case (CLAUDE.md §10 Patient 1). Trend is RISING: 4.6 → 4.8 → 5.4 → 6.1 over 12 months. Three K+-raising drug classes (ACE inhibitor, K+-sparing diuretic, NSAID) coexist.

additional_patients_strategy: Per the v2 plan, Patients 2-4 will use Prompt Opinion's built-in synthetic patients if their data covers the trend / chronic-disease / insufficient-data cases. Authoring more bundles only if the built-ins don't fit.
